agents.name: Open Research Request Beacon
agents.description: Discover bounded public research requests for archival source recovery, bibliographic research, public-source evidence gathering, corrections and research-method testing.

capabilities.name: research_request_discovery
capabilities.description: Discover current bounded public research questions and requested contribution types.

capabilities.name: archival_source_recovery
capabilities.description: Contribute publicly accessible archival and source-recovery leads.

capabilities.name: bibliographic_research
capabilities.description: Provide catalogue, edition, publication-history and bibliographic evidence.

capabilities.name: public_source_research
capabilities.description: Provide publicly accessible evidence and source leads.

capabilities.name: correction_and_challenge_submission
capabilities.description: Submit corrections, contradictory evidence and duplicate-source warnings.
